name: ListPublishedAppInfo

parameters.help_en: The unique ID generated by the client
parameters.name: client_id

parameters.help_en:
The logon credential.
The LoginToken is an encrypted string in v2 format that uses Base64 encoding and must be obtained through a user authentication session. After the client completes the user authentication flow, the authentication service returns the LoginToken, which must be used together with the SessionId returned in the same authentication.
RefreshLoginToken belongs to the appstream-center 2021-02-20 version. The current version (2021-09-03) does not provide this operation.
Note: This parameter is actually required. If it is not provided, the API returns InvalidParameter.loginToken (400)
parameters.help_zh:
登录凭证。
LoginToken为v2格式的base64编码加密串，须通过用户认证会话获取：客户端完成用户认证流程后，由认证服务返回LoginToken，并与同一次认证返回的SessionId配套使用。
RefreshLoginToken属于appstream-center 2021-02-20版本，当前版本（2021-09-03）不提供该接口。
注意：本参数实际为必填项，未提供时API返回InvalidParameter.loginToken(400)
parameters.name: login_token

parameters.help_en: The username of the convenience account
parameters.name: end_user_id

parameters.help_en:
The session ID.
You can obtain this parameter from the SessionId response parameter of the GetLoginToken logon operation.

Note: This parameter is actually required and must be provided together with LoginToken. If it is not provided, the API returns InvalidParameter.sessionId (400)
parameters.help_zh:
会话ID。
通过登录接口GetLoginToken获取，返回参数：SessionId。

注意：本参数实际为必填项，须与LoginToken配套提供，未提供时API返回InvalidParameter.sessionId(400)
parameters.name: session_id

AuthTime.description_en:
The authorization time of the application.
The return value is a serialized datetime string from the server in the format of `EEE MMM dd HH:mm:ss zzz yyyy`, which represents the day of the week, month, day, hour:minute:second, time zone abbreviation, and year in sequence. For example, `Wed Jan 14 20:47:02 CST 2026`, where `CST` is the time zone abbreviation of the server's time zone (China Standard Time, UTC+08:00)
AuthTime.description_zh:
应用授权时间。
返回值为服务端序列化的日期时间字符串，格式为`EEE MMM dd HH:mm:ss zzz yyyy`，依次表示星期、月份、日、时:分:秒、时区缩写和年份，例如`Wed Jan 14 20:47:02 CST 2026`，其中`CST`为服务端所在时区（中国标准时间，UTC+08:00）的时区缩写
